info.name: Makhzoon API
info.description:
Comprehensive API collection for the Makhzoon platform — asset management, inventory, POS (Haraka), custom fields (Banna), and admin tools.

## Conventions (enforced across this collection)
- **JWT authentication always.** Run **Auth → Login (fetch JWT)** once; the token is stored and sent as `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` on every request (collection-level auth).
- **12-hour session.** Login marks the token alive for 12h; a pre-request script auto-refreshes it via the refresh token before expiry. For a literal 12h *access* token, set the Supabase project JWT expiry to 43200s (Dashboard → Authentication → Sessions).
- **Writes carry no URL parameters.** `POST`/`PUT`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` send every identifier and filter in the **JSON body** — no query string, no path params. Fill the `{{...}}` body variables (e.g. `{{assetId}}`) or type values directly.
- **`GET` keeps ids in the URL.** Read endpoints stay RESTful (`/api/assets/{{assetId}}`) because browsers cannot send a body on a GET. Set the matching `{{...}}` path variables.
- **JSON in / JSON out.** Requests send `Content-Type`/`Accept: application/json`; responses are JSON (except file-export endpoints, which stream CSV downloads).

_Set `baseUrl`, `email`, and `password` (collection variables) before running._
